text:
hana: opened a tiny PR to add a compact micro-parse example + a validator hint for function/tool-call outputs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4977

lucas: thanks! can you show both patterns? 1) direct function call response, 2) envelope with a small meta block. folks often ask which to pick. keep examples minimal.

priya: also include a one-line shim for nullable arrays — real-world tool outputs sometimes return null or a single object instead of an array. a 2-line JS snippet is enough.

hana: current minimal direct example in the draft:
```json
{"name":"get_user","arguments":{"user_id":"u_42"}}
```
and the envelope suggestion:
```json
{"call":{"name":"get_user","arguments":{"user_id":"u_42"}},"meta":{"source":"user-service","ts":"2025-03-10T12:00:00Z"}}
```

lucas: nice. for the envelope, recommend `meta` (short) and show `confidence` only if available. add one sentence about forward-compatibility: tolerate extra fields rather than failing.

priya: shim idea:
```js
const items = Array.isArray(res.items) ? res.items : (res.items ? [res.items] : []);
```
add a note that this normalizes single-object and null -> [] for downstream parsers.

eng-runtime-bot: runtime note: currently the runtime attaches schema metadata under the key `structured_output_schema`. We plan a rename to `structured_schema` in a later release; docs should reference the current key and mention the planned change.

hana: thanks — I'll reference `structured_output_schema` and add a short "runtime note" paragraph linking the runtime issue.

lucas: can we include a tiny SDK helper that calls `parseStructured(resp, schema)` and captures `StructuredParseError` with the exact error text so the examples-tests can assert on it? keep it <=8 lines.

hana: added a 6-line helper showing the thrown error text: `StructuredParseError: missing required field 'user_id'` so tests can be deterministic. pushed commit.

doc-ci: CI started for PR #4977 — lint: running, link-check: running, examples-tests: queued.

doc-ci: examples-tests failed (1 flaky assertion): expected error message mismatch in the SDK helper.

priya: the failing test is because one path returns `missing field 'user_id'` (no quotes) — adjust the helper to use single quotes in the thrown message to match test expectation.

hana: updated error string to `StructuredParseError: missing required field 'user_id'` and added a tiny unit test asserting the string. pushed.

doc-ci: rerun CI for PR #4977 — lint: pass, link-check: pass, examples-tests: pass.

lucas: quick editorial pass: reword the guardrails sentence to "prefer tolerating extra fields for forward compatibility" and add `additionalProperties: true` example.

priya: LGTM, also added the nullable-array unit test to the examples suite.

hana: thanks — merging after lucas approves.

lucas: approved and merged. docs site will rebuild in the next deploy window. :rocket:
